caseNameFull: Lemon v. Kurtzman, Superintendent of Public Instruction of Pennsylvania

opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. E. D. Pa. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 397 U. S. 1034.] Motion of Americans United for Separation of Church and State for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae denied.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
